atoms.b: Some people say that raccoons are true ((++omnivores)) because they eat an equal amount of meat and non-meat. Raccoons are scavengers and prefer to ((find)) food rather than kill it themselves. They eat eggs, ((++nuts)), smaller animals and fish. Though raccoons originally lived in forests in North America, they were brought to Europe and Asia by humans and can now also be found in many cities.
